findings.finding: Two distinct source identities and relation identifiers produce the same projected pair under the declared C1 prefix rule.
The result is a counterexample to injectivity for this specified finite projection with respect to the tested source identity and relation fields.
The result does not establish universal information loss or exclude enriched projections that retain additional relation data.

required_follow_up: retain the counterexample in the D gate evidence set
consider whether a source-relation preservation predicate can be independently specified
